close_reason: fixed: fetch cap+1 to detect truncation; exactly cap results no longer triggers total=None
description: email.rs handle_email_query: when collapseThreads or anchor is set and the backend returns exactly COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS=65536 IDs, the code treats that as 'might be capped' and sets total=None, so the response omits the total even if calculateTotal=true. A client that sends calculateTotal:true with collapseThreads:true on an account with exactly 65536 emails will receive no total, with no indication why. The off-by-one means a legitimately cap-free result (fetched_count < cap check) produces None for the boundary case. Maintenance consequence: intermittent missing-total bug reports from accounts near the cap boundary.
title: COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS cap silently omits total from response
